# LocalEmbed

> Public contracts for a PostgreSQL embedding synchronization system.

## Read first

- [Overview](https://localembed.dev/getting-started/): scope and local commands.
- [Configuration contract](https://localembed.dev/contracts/): JSON Schema `localembed/v1`.
- [Query API](https://localembed.dev/api/): OpenAPI contract for `POST /v1/embeddings`.
- [Architecture](https://localembed.dev/architecture/): future runtime roles and boundaries.

## Primary artifacts

- JSON Schema: `contracts/schema/localembed.v1.schema.json`
- Canonical configuration: `contracts/examples/localembed.v1.example.json`
- OpenAPI: `contracts/openapi/localembed.v1.yaml`

## Scope boundary

This version defines contracts and static documentation only. It does not provide a PostgreSQL implementation, queue, worker, embedding inference service, functional HTTP API, or dashboard.
